violations.description: Food supplies. — --Food item was adulterated, contaminated or unsafe for human consumption. -Approximately half a gallon of both mustard and ranch were found in the cooler with a black substance under the lids. -A gallon of milk, half full, had an expiration date of 7/23/26. *The product was thrown out by Gail.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -The ceiling over food prep areas are made of perforated small tiles. Some of those tiles are missing.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. Areas around the fryers should be cleaned following use. The remainder of the facility is very clean. Due to the infrequency in use it is recommended that the areas around the fryers get cleaned at end of use and cover the fryers.
